name: Proem Acquisition Corp I Ordinary Shares
summary: Proem Acquisition Corp. I functions as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), with its core purpose being the execution of a strategic business combination. This could encompass various transaction types, such as a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or corporate reorganization, involving one or more target businesses. Established on July 22, 2025, the firm's main office is located in Dallas, Texas.
